display.purpose: The hero title, all caps: THE DnA CASA, a party's name, HALLOWEEN. A party's name breaks between words or after a hyphen wherever it would overflow a 360px phone, the same breaks on every screen. Its size is picked at build time from Tailwind's text steps (src/lib/hero-title.ts): text-7xl at md, text-8xl at lg, text-9xl at xl and 2xl, stepping down to text-4xl when the longest line would not fit the hero's column. tracking-tighter from md.

headline.purpose: Section headings on every page, set once on h2 in the base layer: text-4xl, then text-5xl at lg and text-6xl from xl. The phone menu links use its text-4xl size.

title.purpose: Member names, contest winners, the drinks, new-this-year titles, the year and name on the Halloween list. text-3xl from md; h3 carries it from the base layer.

subtitle.purpose: Italic: the hero subtitle and a recap's date as its second line. text-xl, then text-2xl at lg and text-3xl from xl.

body.purpose: Running text, at most max-w-sm (384px) wide in the welcome, max-w-md (448px) from xl. text-base, then text-lg from xl.

label.purpose: The Bienvenidos kicker, a recap's contest result, the desktop nav links and the button label. text-xl at every width.

display-phone.purpose: The hero title below md (768px): text-5xl, small enough that HALLOWEEN fits inside the 20px hero gutters from 360px up. A party name with a word too wide to break steps down to text-4xl, on that page only. tracking-tight.

caption.purpose: Member one-liners, photo captions, costume lines, the party theme and date on the list, Made by lines. text-base at every width.

ring.purpose: Stamp ring text, text-base in the ring's 200-unit SVG, so it scales with the stamp; tracking-widest. A longer ring tightens its spacing, never its size.

signoff.purpose: The footer line, italic at text-base.

intro.purpose: A party recap's intro, italic at the subtitle's sizes with leading-snug because it runs to several lines.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Tailwind's --ease-out: the squiggle, the drips, the menu panel and strokes, the button and photo hovers.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Tailwind's --ease-in-out: the link underline on the nav and the Halloween list.

motion.name: duration-steps
motion.purpose: Tailwind's named duration steps in use; a build test fails on any other duration or curve.

motion.name: squiggle-paint
motion.purpose: The squiggle paints on left to right once on load (clip-path inset), through the theme's --animate-paint and motion-safe:animate-paint. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: ring-turn
motion.purpose: The stamp ring turns once every 40s; the trophy keeps the same pace until a visitor pauses or turns it. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: drip-run
motion.purpose: The drips run down once on load. Longhands, because the minifier can fold the shorthand into a form Chrome drops. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: menu-panel
motion.value: opacity and translateY(-0.5rem), 200ms ease-out, transition-behavior allow-discrete, @starting-style
motion.purpose: The phone menu popover fades and slides in; its three strokes turn into an X (transform and opacity, 200ms ease-out). Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.value: transition all 200ms ease-in-out; underline-offset 8px to 4px, decoration transparent to currentColor
motion.purpose: Links react subtly on hover: the underline appears and draws up toward the word. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: The stone's face lifts 2px on hover and presses onto its edge on click or when it stays down. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: photo-hover
motion.purpose: Halloween photos grow slightly on hover. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.value: rise linear both, animation-timeline: view(), animation-range: entry 0% entry 55%; from opacity 0, translateY(1.75rem) (longhands, behind @supports)
motion.purpose: The reveal utility: Halloween sections, photos and rows fade up as they scroll into view; browsers without scroll timelines show them still. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Pages crossfade, with no client-side router. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind default (40rem); the site sets nothing here.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind default (48rem). The phone switch: below it every page is one centered column, the nav folds into the menu button, the gutter becomes --gutter (48px).

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind default (64rem). Steps sizes and gaps up; --gutter 64px.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind default (80rem). Steps sizes and gaps up; --gutter 80px.

breakpoints.name: 2xl
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind default (96rem). Only the hero title's size model reads it.

grain.value: fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.65, 3 octaves, tinted mole, opacity 0.22, mix-blend-mode multiply, position fixed, z-index 50
grain.purpose: The one page-wide paper texture, the .grain layer in the base layer.

gutter.value: --gutter: 48px at md, 64px at lg, 80px from xl; phones take the utility's own step (gutter-x-6 is 24px, gutter-x-5 is 20px)
gutter.purpose: The page's side padding, which is also the gap between side-by-side columns (gutter-x-*, gutter-gap-*). The hero title's size model reads it.

utilities.name: divider
utilities.value: border-top 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-mole) 18%, transparent); the last row also gets a bottom border
utilities.purpose: The hairline between rows: members on phones, winners, parties, the trophy's plates.

utilities.name: gutter-x-*
utilities.value: padding-inline: the phone step; var(--gutter) from md

utilities.name: gutter-gap-*
utilities.value: gap: the phone step; var(--gutter) from md

utilities.name: hero-slot
utilities.purpose: The hero's side slot for the stamp or a recap's invite, from md.

utilities.name: reveal
utilities.purpose: Halloween sections, photos and rows fade up into view.

utilities.name: invite-width
utilities.purpose: Reserves the invite card's box from its own aspect ratio before the file arrives.

utilities.name: frame-strip
utilities.value: grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 160px)); repeat(4, minmax(0, 240px)) from md
utilities.purpose: Stills from one video laid out like a contact strip, centered.

components.name: Footer
components.description: One centered italic serif sign-off on the page's dark field (mole, or Trona on Halloween pages).
components.html: Con cariño · © 2026 The DnA Casa

narrative.overview:
The page is two colors holding a household between them: a deep mole brown above and below, a cream middle, and a marigold sun at the top. Everything else is a small accent on those two fields. It should feel warm, restrained and hand-made: a person made it, and they stopped before it got busy.

Density is low. Each section does one thing: the hero names the page, the middle tells the story, and the footer signs off. The hand shows in a few seeded, drawn shapes (one squiggle, one edge between hero and middle, the soft photo mask, hand-pressed dots, the logo strokes), never in ornament spread across the page. One page-wide grain layer gives both fields a paper feel.

Halloween pages keep the same system and swap one thing: Trona black stands in for mole as the dark field, and drips stand in for the wave. Same fonts, same sizes, same accents.

Rejected and settled: a literal house, many arches, leaf or dappled shadows, squiggles everywhere, heavy hand-drawn ornament, a scrolling word strip, sparkles.
keyCharacteristics: Two big color fields, a dark one and cream, joined by one drawn edge.
Big, tight, all-caps serif wordmark; italic serif for the soft voice.
Accents (pink, gold, terra) only in small doses.
Flat surfaces; depth from grain, not shadows.
Quiet motion, all of it off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The No Black Rule
rules.body: Mole is the darkest color on household pages and Trona black on Halloween pages. Nothing is pure black.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only orange outside the logo. A page or a party never adds its own accent color (pumpkin, lime and plum were tried for Halloween and rejected).

rules.name: The Large Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is about 3.6:1 on page cream, 3.45:1 on mole and 4.26:1 on Trona. Use it for strokes and for text at label size (`text-xl`, 1.25rem, bold) or larger, never for body or caption text.

rules.name: The Logo Exception
rules.body: The Beso logo's three petal oranges (#D9661A, #EC8A1E, #F5A623) are part of the fixed mark and live in its component, not the palette. They appear nowhere else.

rules.name: The Member Color Rule
rules.body: Each member owns one color, in order: Salamander (Dan), Rosa Mexicano (Alexis), Sage (Milly), Marigold (Penny). Don't reuse a member's color to mean something else on the same screen.

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Every text size on every page is one of the roles above, each a Tailwind text step per breakpoint, listed as classes in this file's front matter. A build test reads those classes and fails on any `font-size` in the built CSS, the hand-made pieces' scoped CSS included, that is not one of them. A page never invents its own size; an element that feels too quiet moves up to an existing role instead. Sizes change only at Tailwind's breakpoints, never fluidly with the screen width.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Averia Serif Libre and Schibsted Grotesk only. A new role picks a weight these two already ship before it adds one.

rules.name: The Tight Serif Rule
rules.body: Serif headings set tight, on Tailwind's tracking steps: between `tracking-tight` (-0.025em) and `tracking-tighter` (-0.05em). Display titles are `tracking-tight` on phones, where the line breaks are decided, and `tracking-tighter` from md; section headings are `tracking-tighter`. Display titles and section headings set solid (`leading-none`), titles at `leading-tight` (1.25). The italic voice resets letter spacing to `tracking-normal`.

rules.name: The Wave On Screen Rule
rules.body: At 1440x900 the wave between hero and welcome is visible without scrolling. The welcome's photo and words take equal columns. The members sit in four equal columns across the page column.

rules.name: The First Screen Rule
rules.body: On a 390px-wide phone, the edge (wave or drips) and the start of the cream middle are visible without scrolling.

rules.name: The No Sideways Scroll Rule
rules.body: Nothing scrolls sideways at any width. The hero clips its turning ring horizontally to keep this true.

rules.name: The One Grain Rule
rules.body: One grain layer for the whole page. Sections don't add their own textures.

rules.name: The Seeded Shape Rule
rules.body: A new organic shape comes from the shared seeded generators with a fixed seed, never from randomness at runtime or a stock icon.

rules.name: The No Tilt Rule
rules.body: Photos and cards sit straight. Tilted photos were tried, as scrapbook cuttings and as drama, and dropped everywhere; the only things that turn are the stamp's ring and the menu strokes becoming an X.

rules.name: The Hand-Pressed Dot Rule
rules.body: Cheeks (the Beso's three and the ghost's two) and the ghost's eyes are seeded dots whose edge wobbles about 7%: never perfect circles, never obviously lumpy. The Beso's closed eyes stay brushed strokes.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: One squiggle per hero and one edge where the hero meets the middle (the wave, or the drips on Halloween pages). No sparkles. A new shape has to replace one of these or earn a place the same way.

dos: Do keep the dark field (mole, or Trona on Halloween pages) and page cream as the only large color fields.

Do take every color from the palette: in CSS, from the Tailwind theme's `--color-*` variables; everywhere else (SVG fills, the theme-color meta, the favicon and the link previews), from the palette module, which a test keeps equal to the theme. A build test fails on any other color in the shipped CSS or a `style` attribute, scoped styles included: a color name, a hex, `rgb()` or `hsl()` literal outside the theme. The logo's petal oranges are the one exception.
Do keep accents small: a stroke, a circle, a kicker, an underline.
Do pick every text size from the type scale, and every space, size, radius, duration and breakpoint from Tailwind's scales and the allowed-step list in `src/tailwind-steps.ts`.
Do gate every animation behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do check the phone layout at 390px in device emulation.
donts: Don't use pure black, drop shadows or cards.
Don't add a third typeface or another weight without retiring one.
Don't add an accent color for a page, a section or a party.
Don't set body or caption text in terracotta or pink.
Don't add a marquee, a literal house, arches, leaf shadows, sparkles or extra squiggles.
Don't add motion that bounces, loops (other than the ring and the trophy) or runs longer than half a second (other than the ring, the trophy and the squiggle).
